'''Joe Helfrich''' was named on Decipher's first team of Star Wars '''Player Advocates''', listed under '''Rules Support''' with [[Greg Anderson]].<ref name="pc1">[https://web.archive.org/web/20020611042314/http://decipher.com/starwars/playerscommittee1.html The Star Wars Players' Committee], decipher.com (Wayback, 11 June 2002; letter dated 25 January 2002)</ref>

This page is a '''fan encyclopedia''' stub.

== Documented PC role ==

* '''January 2002:''' First Advocates roster &mdash; Rules Support (with Greg Anderson); Norfolk meeting with Decipher noted on the same announcement.<ref name="pc1" />

Helfrich is '''not''' listed on the swccgpc.com Advocate Council captures used on [[Players Committee advocates]] (December 2002 lists Greg Anderson alone as Rules Advocate). Exact end of his Rules Support term is not dated in those sources.
